items.name: Distribution
items.summary: This object defines probabilistic distributions that encode uncertain information about a single, scalar value. Currently, we support five core statistical distributions. New variants will be added over time.

methods.name: data_type
methods.summary: Returns the data type of the statistical parameters comprising this distribution.

methods.name: new_bernoulli
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Bernoulli`] distribution from the given success probability, and validates the given parameters.

methods.name: new_exponential
methods.signature: fn new_exponential(rate: ScalarValue, offset: ScalarValue, positive_tail: bool) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Exponential`] distribution from the given rate/offset pair, and validates the given parameters.

methods.name: new_from_interval
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Generic`] distribution from the given range. Other parameters (mean, median and variance) are initialized with null values.

methods.name: new_gaussian
methods.signature: fn new_gaussian(mean: ScalarValue, variance: ScalarValue) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Gaussian`] distribution from the given mean/variance pair, and validates the given parameters.

methods.name: new_generic
methods.signature: fn new_generic(mean: ScalarValue, median: ScalarValue, variance: ScalarValue, range: Interval) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Generic`] distribution from the given mean, median, variance, and range values after validating the given parameters.

methods.name: new_uniform
methods.summary: Constructs a new [`Uniform`] distribution from the given [`Interval`].
